# secureaccess_content_categories (Data Source)

This resource reads Content Categories.
 If `items` is empty, all Content Categories are returned, otherwise only the listed ones.
 If `filter` is provided, only Content Categories matching the filter are returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_content_categories" "example" {
  items = {
    "Animals and Pets" = {
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Case-insensitive substring used to filter content category lists by name.
- `items` (Attributes Map) Map of Content Categories. The key of the map is the name of the individual Content Category. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Id of the Content Category.
